headline: FROG LIQUIDATED
chyron: CRYPTO FROG LIQUIDATED AT 3 AM. BROS GRIEVE
ticker: CRYPTO BROS AT CAREERCRASH.ORG/CRYPTOBRO: WATCH THE FROG GET LIQUIDATED, HOURLY
BROS HOLD CANDLELIGHT VIGIL, CANDLES ARE GREEN
CORRESPONDENT'S SCARF "NOT A STORY", SAYS PHILIPPA

beats.text: Chaos in the crypto markets tonight. Our foreign correspondent Rupert Fennimore-Twistleton is on the trading floor.
Philippa. At three o'clock this morning, on this very floor, a coin shaped like a frog was liquidated.
Behind me, the bros are processing what has happened. Some are weeping. Most are buying the dip.
Rupert, Brock here. Big fan. Is that the frog? Waving at the camera?
Philippa. It's lovely to hear your voice again.
We don't need to get into that. It was one dinner. In Belgium. In 2009. I had the soup.
I still have the scarf, Philippa. I wear it in every war zone. Including this one.
Rupert, it's a trading floor. The war is between a dog and a frog.
Back to you in the studio. Au revoir. Auf Wiedersehen. Bon... appétit.

realStory.text: Made up: no frog coin was liquidated at 3 a.m. (that we know of). Crypto Bros is real, though: the top ten coins brawl as crypto bros at careercrash.org/cryptobro, and a coin that tanks gets liquidated every hour. Not financial advice.

signoff: Rupert has sent the scarf back. Philippa has sent it back again. Postage is now a budget line.
